newsitem.title: USA: Vanguard Airlines to add five new non-stop flights.
newsitem.headline: Vanguard Airlines to add five new non-stop flights.

text.p: Vanguard Airlines Inc said on Wednesday it will add five new non-stop destinations from Kansas City, Mo., next month.
The airline will begin non-stop flights to Atlanta, Chicago-Midway, Las Vegas, Orlando, and Tampa/St Petersburg from Kansas City, starting December 21.
The expansion will bring to 12 the total number of non-stop flight destinations the airline offers from Kansas City.

Vanguard also said it will start one-stop service to Miami and Ft Myers from Kansas City on December 21, and it will increase the frequency of flights between Kansas City and Denver, Dallas-Ft Worth and Minneapolis/St Paul as well as between Minneapolis and Chicago-Midway.
The company said its new schedule will raise its capacity by 25 percent.
Vanguard is a low-priced, short- to medium-haul passenger airline that began operating in December 1994.
